# t_funcs.square { #clerq.t_funcs.square }

```python
t_funcs.square(index)
```

Return a square (top-hat) pulse time function.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name   | Type   | Description                                        | Default    |
|--------|--------|----------------------------------------------------|------------|
| index  | int    | Integer suffix used to look up parameters in args. | _required_ |

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type   | Description                                                       |
|--------|--------|-------------------------------------------------------------------|
|        | TFunc  | Callable ``f(t, args)`` reading ``ampl_{index}``, ``on_{index}``, |
|        | TFunc  | ``off_{index}`` from args. Returns ``ampl`` between ``on`` and    |
|        | TFunc  | ``off``, zero outside.                                            |
